results.label: every action refuses an unknown or missing revision before any write
the pause action on an idle timer is a conflict and writes nothing
the resume action on an idle timer is a conflict and writes nothing
the complete action on an idle timer is a conflict and writes nothing
the cancel action on an idle timer is a conflict and writes nothing
start refuses an unlisted bell interval, an unlisted ambience and a mixed length
start refuses an intention over the character cap or with control characters
a valid start is accepted once
a write replayed with a consumed revision is a conflict, never a second write
a paused timer refuses a second pause and a resume starts from paused
a running timer refuses a second resume
a stored timer with an unknown version reads as unavailable, not as a running clock
a write on a corrupt timer fails closed with 503 and no partial row
the timer row is exactly where it was before the corrupt attempts
the note is stored exactly as written, including markup, and escaped only at render
the receipt keeps the measured running time and the pause count
no HTTP route can edit, re-date or delete a receipt
the receipt is unchanged after those attempts
a row this app cannot read is unavailable in the day array while the readable one is not
the corrupted row is not counted as a recorded session
history reports the unreadable row as unavailable rather than repairing it
another trader’s timer is a separate row and is untouched by these writes
this trader’s revision and records are unaffected by the other trader’s write
an unowned or numeric account id is never an input to a practice surface
a completed practice session changes no trade, risk or finance row
the practice payload exposes no permission, gate, score, percentage or streak field
the progress payload states that its numbers are records, not results
a refused practice write never reports a finance change

scope: M108 practice hardening, rollback and no-authority proof: actual runtime/auth/SQL/DOM, fixedUTC and tiny raster/literal journals; not real chart/provider/broker/pixel/production or mental-state proof
